service.name: ui-health
service.description: Framework-agnostic UI manifest validation and UI-surface AI search for Vrooli scenarios

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o ui-health-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

react-component-library.description: Implements InventoryService.ScanScenario for React scenarios; ui-health dispatches per-scenario UI scans to it over Connect-RPC.
react-component-library.degraded_behavior: React scenarios are skipped during reindex; validation findings still emit.

browser-automation-studio.description: Drives the target UI in a real browser over Connect-RPC (CaptureService.Capture + Workflows/Executions) for the runtime/render check group: handshake, storage-shim, console errors, asset/proxy load, theme apply, axe/WCAG, shortcut relay, spatial focus.
browser-automation-studio.degraded_behavior: Runtime/render checks are reported skipped (resource unavailable); all static check groups still run and report.

code-facts.description: Static UI-existence / framework authority (CodeFactsService.DescribeCodeFacts) used to gate UI checks by surface presence and framework, replacing hand-rolled directory/port probing.
code-facts.degraded_behavior: UI-presence gating falls back to manifest/on-disk heuristics; validation still emits.

qdrant.description: Vector database for UI-surface semantic search (collection: ui-health-surface).
qdrant.degraded_behavior: Semantic search falls back to text matching; reindex is deferred.

ollama.description: Local embedding role for UI-surface index generation.
ollama.degraded_behavior: Embedding generation is unavailable; text-mode search still works.
